metadata.title: Real-Time Financial Dashboard Setup & Data Pipeline

story.iWant: a real-time dashboard with core widgets and reliable data pipeline
story.soThat: I have actionable visibility into current financial KPIs

tasks.task: Create materialized views for dashboard data (AC: #2, #5)

criterion.title: Out-of-the-box Widgets
criterion.description: Revenue vs Expenses widget, AR/AP Balance widget, Overdue counts, Cash Position widget, Top 5 Debtors, Top 5 Creditors, Summary dashboard for current period

criterion.title: Data ETL Pipeline
criterion.description: Pipeline job status visible (RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED), Error logs accessible, Last run timestamp, Row counts processed, Admin API endpoint: GET /api/v1/dashboard/etl/status

criterion.title: Data Freshness Indicators
criterion.description: Last updated timestamp, Freshness badge system (GREEN <5min, YELLOW 5-30min, RED >30min), Manual refresh button (admin/chief only, rate-limited), Auto-refresh every 5 minutes

criterion.title: Error Handling & Graceful Degradation
criterion.description: Missing/failed widgets display error banner, Export disabled for unhealthy data, Clear messaging for RUNNING/FAILED state, Fallback to cached data on PostgreSQL query failure, Warning banner for data >24h stale

criterion.title: Performance Requirements
criterion.description: All widget queries complete in <2s (datasets ≤50k transactions), Slow queries (>1s) logged with details, Daily slow query report emailed to admins if >10 slow queries detected

criterion.title: Security & RBAC
criterion.description: Dashboard widgets visible to: Admin, Chief Accountant, Finance, CFO roles. Pipeline configuration editable only by: Admin, Chief Accountant. No cross-company data leaks. API-level RBAC enforcement. 403 Forbidden with audit log for unauthorized access

criterion.title: Audit Trail
criterion.description: All manual refreshes logged with user ID, timestamp, IP address, job ID. All auto-refresh events logged. All configuration changes logged. Retention: 10 years minimum. Audit log table: audit_logs with dashboard-specific action types

artifact.title: Epic 8 Technical Specification: BI Dashboard & Analytics
artifact.snippet: Backend Components: controller/dashboard/, service/analytics/, MetabaseService. Frontend: features/accounting/pages/Dashboard.tsx, features/analytics/. Integration with Metabase for JWT SSO, Redis caching (5min TTL), materialized views for pre-aggregated queries.

artifact.title: Epic 8 Technical Specification: BI Dashboard & Analytics
artifact.snippet: Core entities: DashboardETLRun (tracks pipeline executions), WidgetConfiguration (user layouts), DashboardCache (cache status). Materialized views: mv_daily_revenue_expense, mv_ar_ap_aging, mv_cash_flow_summary with company_id indexes.

artifact.title: Epic 8 Technical Specification: BI Dashboard & Analytics
artifact.snippet: REST endpoints: GET /api/v1/dashboard/metrics, GET /api/v1/dashboard/widget/{widgetId}, POST /api/v1/dashboard/refresh (rate-limited), GET /api/v1/dashboard/etl/status. Roles: Admin, Chief, Finance, CFO.

artifact.title: Epic 8 Technical Specification: BI Dashboard & Analytics
artifact.snippet: Dashboard Load workflow: Check Redis cache (5min TTL), fallback to PostgreSQL materialized views, return with freshness badge. Manual refresh: Rate-limited (1/min), trigger async ETL job, poll status. Nightly ETL: Cron 0 2 * * *, refresh all materialized views, data integrity checks.

artifact.title: Epic 8 Technical Specification: BI Dashboard & Analytics
artifact.snippet: Performance: Widget queries <2s (P95), cache hit rate ≥70%, materialized view refresh within 15min. Security: RBAC at API level, company data isolation via CompanyContext, JWT authentication with Metabase, rate limiting (1 refresh/min). Reliability: ETL failure handling with email alerts, graceful degradation when Redis/Metabase unavailable.

artifact.title: Architecture Decision Records
artifact.snippet: Decision: Use Redis for report caching. Rationale: NFR26 requirement, fast in-memory storage, Spring Boot integration. Dashboard queries cached with 5-minute TTL, manual invalidation on critical data changes.

artifact.title: Security Architecture
artifact.snippet: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Admin, Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO. Spring Security method-level security with API-level permission checks. Company-level data isolation enforced at query level.

artifact.title: Story 8.1 Dev Notes
artifact.snippet: Metabase foundation established: MetabaseService interface/impl, JWT token generation with company_id payload, AnalyticsController created with endpoints for JWT token and iframe URL generation. Frontend integration with @metabase/embedding-sdk-react. DO NOT RECREATE existing patterns.

artifact.reason: Existing Metabase integration interface with JWT token generation and embed URL methods. DO NOT RECREATE - extend with new dashboard-specific methods if needed.
Metabase service implementation with JWT generation using CompanyContext for company_id filtering. Pattern to follow for dashboard JWT generation.
Existing analytics controller with Metabase token/URL endpoints. Base for new dashboard endpoints with RBAC (@PreAuthorize for Admin, CFO, Chief).
Redis cache configuration with TTL settings. Already includes ar-dashboard cache with 5-minute TTL. Pattern to follow for dashboard data caching.
ThreadLocal company context for multi-tenancy. MUST use for all dashboard queries via CompanyContext.getCompanyId() to enforce company data isolation.
Comprehensive audit logging interface with methods for logging dashboard interactions, manual refreshes, exports, and configuration changes. Extend for dashboard-specific audit events.
Frontend service for Metabase integration. Pattern to follow for dashboard API calls with typed responses.
Existing analytics dashboard page with Metabase iframe embedding, loading states, and error handling. Base to extend with new widgets and freshness indicators.

constraints.constraint: All dashboard queries MUST use CompanyContext.getCompanyId() for automatic company_id filtering. Apply @CompanyScoped annotation on service methods.
Use Redis with 5-minute TTL for dashboard widgets. Cache key format: company:{companyId}:widget:{widgetId}:period:{periodId}. Invalidate on manual refresh and period close.
RBAC enforcement at API level using @PreAuthorize. Dashboard visible to: Admin, Chief Accountant, Finance, CFO. Pipeline control restricted to: Admin, Chief Accountant. No cross-company data leaks.
Widget queries MUST complete in <2 seconds (P95) for datasets ≤50k transactions. Use materialized views, Redis caching, and proper indexes. Log slow queries (>1s) with details.
ALL dashboard interactions MUST be logged: page views, widget fetches, manual refreshes, exports, forecast generations, config changes. Retention: 10 years minimum (TT200 compliance).
Implement graceful degradation: fallback to PostgreSQL if Redis unavailable, display error banners for failed widgets, warning banner if data >24h stale.
Materialized views MUST include company_id column with index. Refresh atomically using PostgreSQL transactions. Use REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY to avoid locking.
Manual dashboard refresh: max 1 request per user per minute (429 Too Many Requests if exceeded). Export requests: max 5 per user per hour.
Integration tests MUST verify company data isolation (no cross-company leaks). Performance tests MUST verify <2s widget queries. E2E tests for dashboard load, manual refresh, auto-refresh timer.

Backend package: com.accounting.service.impl.DashboardDataServiceImpl. REST controller: com.accounting.controller.dashboard.DashboardController. DTOs: com.accounting.dto.DashboardMetricsDTO. Frontend: frontend/src/features/analytics/.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/dashboard/metrics
interface.description: Fetch all dashboard metrics (revenue, AR/AP, cash flow). Returns DashboardMetricsDTO with freshness status. Roles: Admin, Chief, Finance, CFO.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/dashboard/widget/{widgetId}
interface.description: Fetch specific widget data by widgetId (revenue_vs_expense, ar_aging, cash_flow, top_debtors, top_creditors). Returns WidgetDataDTO<T>.

interface.name: POST /api/v1/dashboard/refresh
interface.description: Trigger manual dashboard refresh (rate-limited: 1/min). Returns jobId, status, estimatedCompletionTime. Roles: Admin, Chief.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/dashboard/etl/status
interface.description: Get ETL pipeline status and last run details. Returns List<ETLRunStatusDTO>. Roles: Admin.

interface.name: MetabaseService.generateEmbeddingToken
interface.signature: String generateEmbeddingToken(Integer dashboardId, Map<String, Object> params)
interface.description: EXISTING method - DO NOT RECREATE. Generates JWT token for Metabase SSO with company_id filter. Pattern to reuse for dashboard widgets.

interface.name: CompanyContext.getCompanyId
interface.description: MUST use in all dashboard queries to enforce multi-tenant company data isolation. Returns current company ID from ThreadLocal.

interface.name: AuditService logging methods
interface.description: EXTEND with new dashboard-specific audit methods: logDashboardRefresh, logDashboardExport, logDashboardConfigChange. Follow existing pattern with user ID, timestamp, IP address.

tests.standards: Backend: JUnit 5 + Mockito for unit tests, TestContainers for integration tests with PostgreSQL. Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library + jsdom. E2E: Playwright. Coverage target: ≥80% for service layer, ≥70% for controllers. All tests MUST verify company data isolation (no cross-company leaks).

ideas.idea: Test DashboardDataService.getDashboardMetrics() with mocked repositories. Verify Redis cache hit/miss scenarios. Test widget query response time (<2s).
Test ETLPipelineService.executePipeline() with TestContainers PostgreSQL. Verify materialized view refresh, error handling, retry mechanism. Mock email alerts.
Test DataFreshnessService.calculateFreshness() logic for GREEN/YELLOW/RED badge determination based on last ETL run time.
Test graceful degradation: disable Redis and verify fallback to PostgreSQL queries. Verify error banner display for failed widgets.
Test slow query logging: execute widget query with dataset >50k transactions, verify log entry created if duration >1s.
Test RBAC enforcement: attempt dashboard access with ACCOUNTANT role (should succeed), attempt ETL control with FINANCE role (should return 403).
Test company data isolation: set CompanyContext to company A, query dashboard, verify no data from company B returned.
Test AuditService.logDashboardRefresh() method. Verify audit log entry created with user ID, timestamp, IP address, job ID.
E2E test: Load dashboard page, verify auto-refresh timer triggers after 5 minutes, verify new data fetched from API.
E2E test: Click manual refresh button, verify rate limiting (second click within 1 minute returns error), verify ETL job triggered and status updated.
E2E test: Load dashboard with all widgets, verify each widget renders correctly, verify Metabase iframe loads with signed URL.
Performance test: Simulate 20 concurrent users accessing dashboard, verify <2s response time maintained, verify cache hit rate ≥70%.
